name: spartans
title: Delicious Greek Food
subtitle: At Spartan, we make food that matters! We're not just a fast food chain – we're about flavors that win you over and standards that set the bar high. We started small, but now we have over 60 locations where tradition meets modernity. And yes, we're champions at rotisserie meat – every dish has that wow factor that makes you come back for more. Spartan isn't just a name – it's a team of people who love great food. Come join us for a legendary meal!
